svg.title: Post-processing and quality control of Paludamentum
svg.desc: The final annotation of step 5 (or the ab initio genes) runs through the sanity filter, gets UTRs from the StringTie assemblies when there are transcripts, and is written as GFF3, GTF, proteins and CDS. Gene set statistics always run, evidence support in evidence modes; completeness, OMArk, gffcompare, ncRNA and GO terms are switched on by options. report.html sums up all steps.
svg.text: the CDS stays as it is
